subject: Kickoff: arithmetic sampling for diverse decoding
body:
Hi Daniela, team,

Kicking off arithmetic sampling. It's a sampling algorithm for sequence models that gives provably increased beam diversity compared to ordinary sampling in some regimes, plus lower estimator variance — and importantly it parallelizes, because you can precompute the codes for each sample, fix the RNG seed, and decode in batches.

The release is a T5X implementation that plugs into any model accepting an EncoderDecoderModel.decode_fn via gin configs, so integration should be configuration rather than surgery.

Why product cares: our summarization and paraphrase surfaces both suffer from sampled candidates that are near-duplicates. More diversity per unit of compute is directly a quality win.

Milestones: gin integration and CPU-fallback tests by mid-April, diversity and variance study in May, readout the week of June 15.

Dmitri
